name: read-sse
title: readSSE
description: Reads a streamed fetch response as an async iterator, for chat replies and live log tails where EventSource cannot be used (POST bodies, auth headers). `readSSE(response, { signal, maxBufferSize })` follows the WHATWG event-stream rules: streaming UTF-8, BOM, CRLF/LF/CR endings across chunk boundaries, comments, multi-line data, a persistent id and a digits-only retry. `readTextParts` splits on a separator (a line feed by default) for NDJSON. Aborting the signal, leaving the loop early or a stream error cancels the reader once, so the connection closes. An unterminated final block is dropped, as EventSource does. There is no reconnection: keep the last id and retry and send Last-Event-ID yourself. maxBufferSize bounds memory, not time, so abort a stream that goes quiet.
author: gntik-ai
